##### Project general facts

Woodland Crest by AMIS is a boutique residential building where urban energy lives peacefully with nature. Contemporary architecture with clean lines, panoramic windows and high-quality materials blends harmoniously with the surrounding landscape. The building rises above a basement and a spacious ground floor to five residential levels and a rooftop leisure deck, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments designed to high standards of comfort, together with a small selection of retail units at ground level.

Amenities are designed to lift the spirit and support everyday wellbeing. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool and a kids' pool, a state-of-the-art gym, a yoga area and a steam and sauna room. A lounge and library offers a quiet place to read and relax, while a barbecue area, a kids' play area, landscaped gardens and seating areas create inviting outdoor spaces. A welcoming lobby, covered parking, round-the-clock security and a concierge service complete the offer.

Interiors are styled in a contemporary way with premium finishing materials, intuitive layouts and sunlit living spaces. Every detail is designed for maximum comfort and functionality, with open living and dining areas that flow onto balconies and bedrooms offering quiet, comfortable retreats. Kitchens are fitted with appliances, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style, while lush landscaping frames views from the windows.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is a prestigious district of Dubai inspired by the vision of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, home to the Meydan Racecourse, The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Golf. Nad Al Sheba combines calm residential streets, landscaped parklands, cafes and top-rated schools with quick access to the city centre, offering a balanced lifestyle for families and professionals.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Al Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Hills Mall are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah are within comfortable reach, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the surrounding communities.

Meydan is a freehold area with strong appeal for professionals and families seeking a calm address close to Downtown Dubai. Boutique residential buildings with resort-style amenities attract steady demand from tenants working in the city's main business hubs, supporting attractive rental yields. A central position, green surroundings and an established lifestyle offer underpin long-term value and capital growth for owners and investors.
